strategy.overview: Complete the five center drops in order from right to left, then use the upper P-O-O-L lanes to raise Bonus X. Next hit the recessed 6-ball at lower left, the recessed 7-ball at lower right, and the 8-ball at the far upper left through a strong right orbit. After the first rack, the same route continues through balls 9–15, while P-O-O-L and B-A-L-L provide safer progress.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit the five center drops in order from right to left, then complete P-O-O-L lanes for Bonus X. Finish the rack with the recessed 6-ball, recessed 7-ball, and far upper-left 8-ball reached through the right orbit.
strategy.summary: Complete the center drops from right to left, build Bonus X with P-O-O-L, then hit the recessed 6- and 7-ball targets and the far upper-left 8-ball through the right orbit. Repeat the numbered-ball route for the next rack.

quickInfo.name: Clear Drops Right to Left
quickInfo.summary: Out-of-order hits reset the target sequence.

quickInfo.name: Finish 6, 7, and 8
quickInfo.summary: Use both recessed targets, then the far upper-left 8-ball.

quickInfo.name: Use B-A-L-L
quickInfo.summary: A completed set spots the next numbered ball and lights the spinner.

steps.text: Hit the five center drop targets in order from right to left; an out-of-order hit resets the sequence.
Send the ball up top and complete P-O-O-L to advance end-of-ball Bonus X.
Hit the recessed 6-ball at lower left, then the recessed 7-ball at lower right.
Shoot a strong right orbit to reach the far upper-left 8-ball and complete the first rack; then repeat the route for balls 9–15.

alternatives.title: Spot the next ball
alternatives.when: Use this when the required numbered target is unsafe or a B-A-L-L set is nearly complete.

steps.text: Complete B-A-L-L to spot the next numbered ball and light the left spinner.
Complete P-O-O-L for Bonus X and one B-A-L-L letter, then resume the numbered rack.
Keep numbered-ball progress moving while P-O-O-L raises Bonus X through 5x, 7x, 10x, 15x, and 20x.
At 10x or higher, account for the setting that returns Bonus X to 5x after the ball.

machineSetup: Confirm Extra Ball and Special conversions, Bonus X carry and maximum, first-rack double spotting, lane change, and whether B-A-L-L spots the next ball.
Test all five ordered center drops, recessed 6/14 and 7/15 targets, right orbit and 8-ball, P-O-O-L lanes, B-A-L-L and C-U-E targets, upper mini-flipper, left spinner, and trough.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: After the 7-ball rebound, use a tested dead bounce from the paired right flippers to the left before shooting the 8-ball.

cautions.issue: The paired right flippers can trap or lose a ball between them during a passive bounce.
cautions.response: Test the 6–7–8 combo on this copy and use an active catch when the return does not cross the pair cleanly.
